content:
Haritha Karma Sena Waste Management Guidelines (Demo RAG Document)
This is a demo document for an AI-powered RAG chatbot.
Waste Categories
Wet/Bio, Dry (plastic, paper, glass, metal), E-waste, Hazardous waste.
Segregation Rules
Separate waste at source. Empty plastic bottles before disposal. Do not mix food waste with plastic. Batteries must be handed over separately.
Collection Schedule
Household waste collection is conducted every weekend. Saturday: Wards 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. Sunday: Wards 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10. Citizens should keep segregated waste ready before 8:00 AM on their collection day.
User Fee
A monthly user fee of ₹50 per household shall be paid to Haritha Karma Sena for waste collection services. The fee supports collection, transportation and processing of waste.
Haritha Karma Sena Responsibilities
Collect segregated waste, educate citizens, ensure safe transport, and report illegal dumping.
Government Guidelines
Use authorized centres for e-waste. Avoid mixing hazardous waste with household waste.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Which wards are covered on Saturday?
A: Wards 1 to 5.
Q: Which wards are covered on Sunday?
A: Wards 6 to 10.
Q: What is the monthly collection fee?
A: ₹50 per household.
Q: Which bin should I use for plastic?
A: Blue bin.
Q: Which bin should I use for food waste?
A: Green bin.
Q: How should batteries be disposed?
A: Through an authorized e-waste collection centre.
